info.title: Trove
info.description:
Trove is a job-search portal shared by **candidates** and their **headhunters**
(human or AI).

* Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`: a session token from
  `POST /api/auth/login`, or a headhunter API key (`trove_…`) created in the UI.
* Wherever a `candidate_id` is accepted, `me` means the caller.
* The same operations are exposed as **MCP tools** over streamable HTTP at `/mcp`;
  each tool is named after the `operationId` of its REST counterpart.

get.description: Readiness — checks the database; 503 when it is unreachable.
Current build plus the URLs integrations need. Requires authentication.

post.description: Exchange email + password for a bearer token.

get.description: Tells the login page which options to render.

post.description: Start Google sign-in. `link` requires a session; send the browser to the returned URL.
Finish Google sign-in with the code from Google's redirect; returns a session token.
Link the Google account from Google's redirect to the signed-in user.

delete.description: Unlink Google from the signed-in user (they must have a password).

post.description: Create a key. The full key is returned once; only a hash is stored.

get.description: Every candidate, with resume and job counts (headhunters only).
A candidate's search preferences and base-resume metadata.

put.description: Replace the candidate's search preferences (titles, salary, locations…).
Upload (or replace) the candidate's detailed, generic base resume.

get.description: Download the original base resume file.
Base resume metadata and extracted plain text, for rewriting by an AI headhunter.
